question: A set has 5 elements. How many subsets does it have?
why: A set with n elements has 2^n subsets, so 2^5 = 32.

question: In a class of 50 students, 30 play cricket, 25 play football and 10 play both. How many play neither game?
why: Either game = 30 + 25 - 10 = 45. Neither = 50 - 45 = 5.

question: U = {1, 2, ..., 10}, A is the set of even numbers and B is the set of multiples of 3 in U. Find n((A U B)').
why: A U B = {2, 3, 4, 6, 8, 9, 10} has 7 elements, so the complement {1, 5, 7} has 3.

question: In a group, n(A) = 40, n(B) = 35, n(C) = 30, n(A and B) = 12, n(B and C) = 10, n(A and C) = 8 and n(A and B and C) = 5. How many belong to exactly one of the three sets?
why: Only A = 25, only B = 18, only C = 17, total 60. The union (80) counts members of two or three sets as well.

question: If A has 3 elements, how many elements does P(P(A)) have? (P is the power set.)
why: P(A) has 2^3 = 8 elements, so P(P(A)) has 2^8 = 256 elements.

question: If n(A) = 4 and n(B) = 3, how many elements does A x B have?
why: n(A x B) = n(A) x n(B) = 4 x 3 = 12.

question: What is the range of f(x) = x / (1 + x^2)?

question: A committee of 4 is chosen from 6 men and 5 women with at least 2 women. How many committees are possible?

question: In how many ways can the letters of MISSISSIPPI be arranged so that no two S are together?
why: Arrange the other 7 letters: 7!/(4! 2!) = 105. Choose 4 of the 8 gaps for the S: C(8,4) = 70. 105 x 70 = 7350.

question: How many triangles can be formed from the vertices of a regular decagon so that no side of the triangle is a side of the decagon?
why: Total C(10,3) = 120. Triangles with two decagon sides: 10. With exactly one side: 10 x 6 = 60. So 120 - 70 = 50.

why: Cancel x - 2 to get x + 2, which tends to 4.

question: What is the mean deviation about the mean of 4, 8, 12, 16, 20?

question: What is the variance of 2, 4, 6, 8, 10?

question: Ten observations have mean 20 and standard deviation 4. What is the sum of their squares?
why: Variance = mean of squares - mean^2, so the mean of squares = 16 + 400 = 416. Times 10 gives 4160.

question: A data set has mean 50 and standard deviation 12. What is its coefficient of variation?

why: Sum of squares = 5 x (4 + 36) = 200, plus 144 = 344. New mean 42/6 = 7. Variance = 344/6 - 49 = 25/3.

question: 20 observations have mean 15 and SD 4. One observation, 8, was wrongly copied and should be 20. What is the corrected SD?
why: Correct sum = 312, mean 15.6. Sum of squares = 4820 - 64 + 400 = 5156. Variance = 257.8 - 243.36 = 14.44, so SD = 3.8.
